name: Point Lookout Light
text: Point Lookout Light is a lighthouse that marks the entrance to the Potomac River at the southernmost tip of Maryland's western shore of the Chesapeake Bay, south of the town of Scotland in Saint Mary's County, Maryland, USA. The lighthouse is located in Point Lookout State Park. The lighthouse is now open to the public, as of May 2025, as a museum during the summertime.
